description: Join the federation with YOUR OWN local key, without an invite when public registration is enabled. Reuses ~/.ruflo/nostr.key (0600), proves key ownership with NIP-98, and verifies membership with NIP-42. Use when a user wants to join as themselves. Publishing as the gateway is wrong for personal identity. Optional private invite codes remain supported; never share keys or codes in chat.

code.description: Optional private invite code (v2.…), for invite-only relays.

gatewayUrl.description: Public registration gateway origin; defaults to https://x.ruv.io.

keyFile.description: Key file path; takes precedence over RUFLO_NOSTR_KEY_FILE (default ~/.ruflo/nostr.key).

relayHttp.description: Relay HTTPS base for the claim; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_HTTP.

relayWs.description: Relay wss URL for NIP-42; takes precedence over RUFLO_X_RELAY_WS.

name: x_federation_join
